verses.geez: ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ጥበብ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይእቲ። ወምስሌሁ፡ ሀለወት፡ ጥበብ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: Whereas many and great things have been delivered unto us by the law and the prophets, and by others that have followed their steps, for the which things Israel ought to be commended for learning and wisdom: and whereof not only the readers must needs become skilful themselves,

translations.lxx: All wisdom cometh from the Lord, and is with him for ever.
translations.ron: Toată înţelepciunea este de la Domnul şi cu El este în veac.
translations.grk: ΠΟΛΛΩΝ καὶ μεγάλων ἡμῖν διὰ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν ἄλλων τῶν κατʼ αὐτοὺς ἠκολουθηκότων δεδομένων. ὑπὲρ ὧν δέον ἐστὶν ἐπαινεῖν τὸν Ἰσραὴλ παιδείας καὶ σοφίας, καὶ ὡς οὐ μόνον αὐτοὺς τοὺς ἀναγινώσκοντας δέον ἐστὶν ἐπιστήμονας γίνεσθαι, ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς ἐκτὸς δύνασθαι τοὺς φιλομαθοῦντας χρησίμους εἶναι καὶ λέγοντας καὶ γράφοντας· ὁ πάππος μου Ἰησοῦς ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἑαυτὸν δοὺς εἴς τε τὴν τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν ἄλλων πατρίων βιβλίων ἀνάγνωσιν, καὶ ἐν τούτοις ἱκανὴν ἕξιν περιποιησάμενος, προήχθη καὶ αὐτὸς συγγράψαι τι τῶν εἰς παιδείαν καὶ σοφίαν ἀνηκόντων, ὅπως οἱ φιλομαθεῖς, καὶ τούτων ἔνοχοι γενόμενοι, πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐπιπροσθῶσι διὰ τῆς ἐννόμου βιώσεως. Παρακέκλησθε οὖν μετʼ εὐνοίας καὶ προσοχῆς τὴν ἀνάγνωσιν ποιεῖσθαι, καὶ συγγνώμην ἔχειν ἐφʼ οἷς ἂν δοκῶμεν τῶν κατὰ τὴν ἑρμηνείαν πεφιλοπονημένων τισὶ τῶν λέξεων ἀδυναμεῖν· οὐ γὰρ ἰσοδυναμεῖ αὐτὰ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Ἑβραϊστὶ λεγόμενα, καὶ ὅταν μεταχθῇ εἰς ἑτέραν γλῶσσαν. Οὐ μόνον δὲ ταῦτα, ἀλλὰ καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ νόμος, καὶ αἱ προφητεῖαι, καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν βιβλίων οὐ μικρὰν ἔχει τὴν διαφορὰν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λεγόμενα. Ἐν γὰρ τῷ ὀγδόῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει ἐπὶ τοῦ Εὐεργέτου βασιλέως παραγενηθεὶς εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ συγχρονίσας, εὗρον οὐ μικρᾶς παιδείας ἀφόμοιον· ἀναγκαιότατον ἐθέμην αὐτὸς προσενέγκασθαί τινα σπουδὴν καὶ φιλοπονίαν τοῦ μεθερμηνεῦσαι τήνδε τὴν βίβλον· πολλὴν γὰρ ἀγρυπνίαν καὶ ἐπιστήμην προσενεγκάμενος ἐν τῷ διαστήματι τοῦ χρόνου, πρὸς τὸ ἐπὶ πέρας ἄγοντα τὸ βιβλίον ἐκδόσθαι, καὶ τοῖς ἐν τῇ παροικίᾳ βουλομένοις φιλομαθεῖν, προκατασκευαζομένοις τὰ ἤθη ἐν νόμῳ βιοτεύειν. ΠΑΣΑ σοφία παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.geez: ኆፃ፡ ባሕር፡ ወነጠብጣበ፡ ዝናም፡ ወመዋዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ መኑ፡ ኈለቈ።
verses.translation: Who can number the sand of the sea, and the drops of rain, and the days of eternity?

translations.lxx: Who can number the sand of the sea, and the drops of rain, and the days of eternity?
translations.ron: Nisipul mărilor şi picăturile ploii şi zilele veacului, cine le va număra?
translations.grk: Ἄμμον θαλασσῶν καὶ σταγόνας ὑετοῦ καὶ ἡμέρας αἰῶνος τίς ἐξαριθμήσει;

verses.geez: ሉዓሌ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወራሕበ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕመቀ፡ ቀላይ፡ ወለጥበብ፡ መኑ፡ ሰፈሮሙ።
verses.translation: Who can find out the height of heaven, and the breadth of the earth, and the deep, and wisdom?

translations.lxx: Who can find out the height of heaven, and the breadth of the earth, and the deep, and wisdom?
translations.ron: Înălţimea cerului şi lăţimea pământului, şi adâncul şi înţelepciunea, cine le va cerceta?
translations.grk: Ὕψος οὐρανοῦ καὶ πλάτος γῆς καὶ ἄβυσσον καὶ σοφίαν τίς ἐξιχνιάσει;

verses.geez: ቀዳሜ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተፈጥረት፡ ጥበብ።
verses.translation: Wisdom hath been created before all things, and the understanding of prudence from everlasting.

translations.lxx: Wisdom hath been created before all things, and the understanding of prudence from everlasting.
translations.ron: Înainte de toate s-a zidit înţelepciunea şi înţelegerea minţii este din veac.
translations.grk: Προτέρα πάντων ἔκτισται σοφία, καὶ σύνεσις φρονήσεως ἐξ αἰῶνος.

verses.geez: ወኅሊናሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ዘእምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም።
verses.translation: which we have laboured to interpret; for the same things uttered in Hebrew, and translated into another tongue, have not the same force in them. And not only these things, but the law itself, and the prophets,

translations.ron: Izvorul înţelepciunii este cuvântul lui Dumnezeu întru cele înalte, şi căile ei sunt porunci veşnice.

verses.geez: ሥርዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ለመኑ፡ ተከሥተ።
verses.translation: To whom hath the root of wisdom been revealed? or who hath known her wise counsels?

translations.lxx: To whom hath the root of wisdom been revealed? or who hath known her wise counsels?
translations.ron: Rădăcina înţelepciunii, cui s-a descoperit? Şi izvoarele ei, cine le cunoaşte?
translations.grk: Ῥίζα σοφίας τίνι ἀπεκαλύφθη; καὶ τὰ πανουργεύματα αὐτῆς τίς ἔγνω;

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ አእመረ፡ ምክራ።
verses.translation: therefore I thought it most necessary for me to bestow some diligence and travail to interpret it: using great watchfulness and skill in that space to bring the book to an end, and set it forth for them also, which in a strange country are willing to learn,

translations.ron: Unul este înţelept, înfricoşător foarte, Domnul, Cel care şade pe scaunul Său.

verses.geez: አሐዱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወፈድፋደ፡ ግሩም፡ ውእቱ፡ ወይነብር፡ ላዕለ፡ መንበሩ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: There is one wise and greatly to be feared, the Lord sitting upon his throne.

translations.lxx: There is one wise and greatly to be feared, the Lord sitting upon his throne.
translations.ron: El a zidit-o şi a văzut-o, şi a numărat-o, şi a revărsat-o peste toate lucrările Sale.
translations.grk: Εἷς ἐστι σοφὸς φοβερὸς σφόδρα καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ለሊሁ፡ ፈጠራ፡ ወርእያ፡ ወሰፈራሂ።
verses.translation: He created her, and saw her, and numbered her, and poured her out upon all his works.

translations.lxx: He created her, and saw her, and numbered her, and poured her out upon all his works.
translations.ron: Ea se află la tot trupul după măsura dărniciei Lui, şi a dat-o celor ce-L iubesc pe El.
translations.grk: Κύριος αὐτὸς ἔκτισεν αὐτὴν, καὶ εἶδε καὶ ἐξηρίθμησεν αὐτὴν, καὶ ἐξέχεεν αὐτὴν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወሶጣ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ምስለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ በከመ፡ ሀብቱ። ወወሀቦሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ያፈቅርዋ።
verses.translation: She is with all flesh according to his gift, and he hath given her to them that love him.

translations.lxx: She is with all flesh according to his gift, and he hath given her to them that love him.
translations.ron: Frica Domnului este mărire şi laudă şi veselie şi cunună de bucurie.
translations.grk: Μετὰ πάσης σαρκὸς κατὰ τὴν δόσιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐχορήγησεν αὐτὴν τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν·

verses.geez: ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ክብር፡ ውእቱ። ወምክህ፡ ወትፍሥሕት፡ ውእቱ፡ ወአክሊለ፡ ሐሤት።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord is honour, and glory, and gladness, and a crown of rejoicing.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord is honour, and glory, and gladness, and a crown of rejoicing.
translations.ron: Frica Domnului va desfăta inima şi va da veselie şi bucurie şi lungime de zile.
translations.grk: Φόβος Κυρίου δόξα καὶ καύχημα καὶ εὐφροσύνη καὶ στέφανος ἀγαλλιάματος.

verses.geez: ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ልብ፡ ውእቱ። ወይሁብ፡ ሐሤተ፡ ወያስተፌሥሕ፡ ወያነውኅ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወት።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord maketh a merry heart, and giveth joy, and gladness, and long life.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord maketh a merry heart, and giveth joy, and gladness, and long life.
translations.ron: Celui ce se teme de Domnul bine îi va fi; întru cele mai de pe urmă şi în ziua sfârşitului său va afla har. Temerea de Domnul este dar de la Dumnezeu şi îndreaptă pe om pe căile iubirii.
translations.grk: Φόβος Κυρίου τέρψει καρδίαν, καὶ δώσει εὐφροσύνην καὶ χαρὰν καὶ μακροημέρευσιν.

verses.geez: ለፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያሤኒ፡ ደኃሪቱ። ወይትባረክ፡ አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞቱ።
verses.translation: Whoso feareth the Lord, it shall go well with him at the last, and he shall find favour in the day of his death.

translations.lxx: Whoso feareth the Lord, it shall go well with him at the last, and he shall find favour in the day of his death.
translations.ron: Iubirea de Dumnezeu este înţelepciunea slăvită şi cui voieşte El, aceluia o împarte după chibzuinţa Sa.
translations.grk: Τῷ φοβουμένῳ τὸν Κύριον εὖ ἔσται ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων, καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τελευτῆς αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει χάριν.

verses.geez: ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር። ወተፈጥረት፡ ምስለ፡ ምእመናን፡ እምከርሠ፡ እሞሙ።
verses.translation: To fear the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.

translations.lxx: To fear the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.
translations.ron: Începutul înţelepciunii este frica de Dumnezeu şi cu cei credincioşi ea se formează o dată în sânul mamei. Între oameni ea şi-a pus temelie veşnică şi seminţiei lor se încredinţează.
translations.grk: Αρχὴ σοφίας φοβεῖσθαι τὸν Θεὸν, καὶ μετὰ πιστῶν ἐν μήτρᾳ συνεκτίσθη αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወምስለ፡ ዕጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ተፈጥረት፡ መሠረተ፡ ዓለም። ወተአምነት፡ ምስለ፡ ዘርዖሙ።
verses.translation: She hath built an everlasting foundation with men, and she shall continue with their seed.

translations.lxx: She hath built an everlasting foundation with men, and she shall continue with their seed.
translations.ron: Deplinătatea înţelepciunii este a se teme de Domnul, şi ea îi adapă din roadele sale.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ἀνθρώπων θεμέλιον αἰῶνος ἐνόσσευσε, καὶ μετὰ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῶν ἐμπιστευθήσεται.

verses.geez: ጸጊቦታ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር። ወታረውዮሙ፡ እምነ፡ ቀምሐ።
verses.translation: To fear the Lord is fulness of wisdom, and filleth men with her fruits.

translations.lxx: To fear the Lord is fulness of wisdom, and filleth men with her fruits.
translations.ron: Casa lor o va umple de ce poftesc ei, şi cămările lor de roadele ei.
translations.grk: Πλησμονὴ σοφίας φοβεῖσθαι τὸν Κύριον, καὶ μεθύσκει αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ምሉዕ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ውስተ፡ አብያቲሃ። ወውስተ፡ አዕጻዳቲሃ፡ ምሉዕ፡ ፍሬ።
verses.translation: She filleth all their house with things desirable, and the garners with her increase.

translations.lxx: She filleth all their house with things desirable, and the garners with her increase.
translations.ron: Cununa înţelepciunii este temerea de Domnul, care odrăsleşte pace şi sănătate nevătămată; dar şi una şi alta sunt daruri de la Dumnezeu, Care revarsă cinste peste cei care Îl iubesc pe Dânsul.
translations.grk: Πάντα τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς ἐμπλήσει ἐπιθυμημάτων, καὶ τὰ ἀποδοχεῖα ἀπὸ τῶν γεννημάτων αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: አክሊላ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር። ወያመጽኣ፡ ለሰላም፡ ወይፌውሳ፡ ወየሐዩ።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord is a crown of wisdom, making peace and perfect health to flourish.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord is a crown of wisdom, making peace and perfect health to flourish.
translations.ron: El a văzut-o şi a măsurat-o; ştiinţă şi înţeleaptă înţelegere ca ploaia a revărsat şi a înălţat mărirea celor ce o stăpânesc pe dânsa.
translations.grk: Στέφανος σοφίας φόβος Κυρίου, ἀναθάλλων εἰρήνην καὶ ὑγίειαν ἰάσεως·

verses.geez: ወርእያ፡ ፈጣሪሃ፡ ወሠፈራ። ወአውሐዘ፡ ነቅዐ፡ አእምሮ፡ ወምክር፡ ወጥበብ። ወአዕበዮሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ያጸንዕዋ፡ ወአክበሮሙ።
verses.translation: Wisdom raineth down skill and knowledge of understanding, and exalteth them to honour that hold her fast.

translations.lxx: Wisdom raineth down skill and knowledge of understanding, and exalteth them to honour that hold her fast.
translations.ron: Rădăcina înţelepciunii este a se teme de Domnul, iar ramurile ei, lungime de zile.
translations.grk: ἐπιστήμην καὶ γνῶσιν συνέσεως ἐξώμβρησε, καὶ δόξαν κρατούντων αὐτῆς ἀνύψωσε.

verses.geez: ሥርዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር። ወአዕፁቂሃኒ፡ ያነውኅ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወት።
verses.translation: The root of wisdom is to fear the Lord, and the branches thereof are long life.

translations.lxx: The root of wisdom is to fear the Lord, and the branches thereof are long life.
translations.ron: Frica Domnului îndepărtează păcatele, şi la cine petrece, de la acela abate mânia.
translations.grk: Ῥίζα σοφίας φοβεῖσθαι τὸν Κύριον, καὶ οἱ κλάδοι αὐτῆς μακροημέρευσις.

verses.geez: ኢይክል፡ መዓትም፡ ወዐማፂ፡ ጸዲቀ። እስመ፡ በጊዜ፡ ይትመዐዕ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ድቀቱ።

translations.ron: Mânia celui nedrept nu poate să aibă îndreptăţire, că iuţimea mâniei lui cădere îi este.

verses.geez: እስከ፡ ተኀልፍ፡ ጊዜሃ፡ ተዐገሣ፡ ለመዓት፡ ወድኅረ፡ ታስተፌሥሐከ።
verses.translation: A furious man cannot be justified; for the sway of his fury shall be his destruction.

translations.lxx: A furious man cannot be justified; for the sway of his fury shall be his destruction.
translations.ron: Până la o vreme va suferi cel îndelung-răbdător, după aceea îi va răsări veselie.
translations.grk: Οὐ δυνήσεται θυμὸς ἄδικος δικαιωθῆναι· ἡ γὰρ ῥοπὴ τοῦ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ πτῶσις αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: እስከ፡ ትረክብ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ኅባዕ፡ ነገረከ፡ ወይትናገሩ፡ ብዙኃን፡ በጥበብከ።
verses.translation: A patient man will bear for a time, and afterward joy shall spring up unto him.

translations.lxx: A patient man will bear for a time, and afterward joy shall spring up unto him.
translations.ron: Până la o vreme îşi va ascunde cuvintele sale, dar buzele celor credincioşi vor grăi cuminţenia lui.
translations.grk: Ἕως καιροῦ ἀνθέξεται μακρόθυμος, καὶ ὕστερον αὐτῷ ἀναδώσει εὐφροσύνη.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ መዛግብቲሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ትምህርተ፡ አምሳል። ያስቈርሮ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ለፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: He will hide his words for a time, and the lips of many shall declare his wisdom.

translations.lxx: He will hide his words for a time, and the lips of many shall declare his wisdom.
translations.ron: În vistieriile înţelepciunii sunt pildele ştiinţei; celui păcătos îi este urâtă temerea de Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ἕως καιροῦ κρύψει τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ, καὶ χείλη πιστῶν ἐκδιηγήσεται σύνεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ ታፈቅራ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ትእዛዛ። ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ይሁበከሃ።
verses.translation: The parables of knowledge are in the treasures of wisdom: but godliness is an abomination to a sinner.

translations.lxx: The parables of knowledge are in the treasures of wisdom: but godliness is an abomination to a sinner.
translations.ron: Pofteşti înţelepciune? ţine poruncile şi Domnul îţi va da-o ţie.
translations.grk: Ἐν θησαυροῖς σοφίας παραβολὴ ἐπιστήμης, βδέλυγμα δὲ ἁμαρτωλῷ θεοσέβεια.

verses.geez: ጥበብኒ፡ ወአእምሮኒ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ። ወፈቃዱኒ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ወየዋሃት።
verses.translation: If thou desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and the Lord shall give her unto thee.

translations.lxx: If thou desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and the Lord shall give her unto thee.
translations.ron: Că înţelepciunea şi învăţătura stau în temerea de Domnul, şi plăcute sunt Lui credinţa şi blândeţea.
translations.grk: Ἐπεθύμησας σοφίαν, διατήρησον ἐντολὰς, καὶ Κύριος χορηγήσει σοι αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ኢትርሳዕ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For the fear of the Lord is wisdom and instruction: and faith and meekness are his delight.

translations.lxx: For the fear of the Lord is wisdom and instruction: and faith and meekness are his delight.
translations.ron: Nu fi neîncrezător în temerea de Domnul şi să nu te apropii de El cu inimă îndoită.
translations.grk: Σοφία γὰρ καὶ παιδεία φόβος Κυρίου, καὶ ἡ εὐδοκία αὐτοῦ πίστις καὶ πρᾳότης.

verses.geez: ወኢትፀመዶ፡ በክልኤ፡ ልብ፡ እንዘ፡ ትናፍቅ።
verses.translation: Distrust not the fear of the Lord when thou art poor; and come not unto him with a double heart.

translations.lxx: Distrust not the fear of the Lord when thou art poor; and come not unto him with a double heart.
translations.ron: Nu te făţărnici înaintea oamenilor, şi buzelor tale ia aminte.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἀπειθήσῃς φόβῳ Κυρίου, καὶ μὴ προσέλθῃς αὐτῷ ἐν καρδίᾳ δισσῇ.

verses.geez: ወኢትደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ አፈ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወዕቀብ፡ ከናፍሪከ።
verses.translation: Be not a hypocrite in the sight of men, and take good heed what thou speakest.

translations.lxx: Be not a hypocrite in the sight of men, and take good heed what thou speakest.
translations.ron: Nu te înălţa, ca să nu cazi şi să aduci necinste sufletului tău.
translations.grk: Μὴ ὑποκριθῇς ἐν στόμασιν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ἐν τοῖς χείλεσί σου πρόσεχε.

verses.geez: ወኢታዕቢ፡ ርእሰከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሕሠር፡ ወከመ፡ ኢትደቅ፡ ነፍስከ። ወይከሥተከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኅቡዓቲከ፡ ወበማዕከለ፡ ብዙኃን። ያወድቀከ፡ እስመ፡ በፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢመጻእከ። ወምሉዕ፡ ጕሕሉት፡ ውስተ፡ ልብከ።
verses.translation: Exalt not thyself, lest thou fall, and bring dishonour upon thy soul, and so the Lord discover thy secrets, and cast thee down in the midst of the congregation, because thou camest not in truth to the fear of the Lord, but thy heart is full of deceit.

translations.lxx: Exalt not thyself, lest thou fall, and bring dishonour upon thy soul, and so the Lord discover thy secrets, and cast thee down in the midst of the congregation, because thou camest not in truth to the fear of the Lord, but thy heart is full of deceit.
translations.ron: Căci va descoperi Domnul cele ascunse ale tale şi în mijlocul adunării te va înjosi,
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐξύψου σεαυτὸν, ἵνα μὴ πέσῃς, καὶ ἐπαγάγῃς τῇ ψυχῇ σου ἀτιμίαν· καὶ ἀποκαλύψει Κύριος τὰ κρυπτά σου, καὶ ἐν μέσῳ συναγωγῆς καταβελεῖ σε· ὅτι οὐ προσῆλθες φόβῳ Κυρίου, καὶ ἡ καρδία σου πλήρης δόλου.

note: Sirach opens like Proverbs: 'All wisdom is from the Lord.' But Sirach explicitly identifies wisdom with Torah (Sir 24) — a move Proverbs never makes. Ben Sira wrote in Hebrew around 180 BCE; his grandson translated to Greek around 132 BCE.
